stage: Phase 3a-B P0-4 (measurement is P2-3: after the AI coach and the semantics freeze, with separate Owner approval)
status: draft: NOT runnable until (1) the AI coach (T15) is merged, because the red side's behaviour in career.v21 comes from it, (2) the measurement entry tool exists with a selftest, (3) the semantics freeze; then re-committed as 'registered' before the run
authority: 3a-B kickoff checklist §5 (structure ✅ / behaviour ❌ / outcome ❌): the n=400 evidence was measured on balanceTool.v21 (red std, no player stats); career.v21 differs (red = AI coach, blue player stats, items/talents per flags), so the effect sizes cannot be carried over without a behaviour check through the formal entry
question: Do the live v21 choices, when entered through the formal career path (prepareLiveMatch with career.v21), still move the registered behaviour in the registered direction on the player's side?

seeds.range: 23001-23799 odd only (400 distinct effectiveSeeds; normalizeLiveSeed(s,'session') = s)
seeds.opponents: AI_TEAMS[seed % 7] (57-58 matches per team; the same rule as measure_laneframe_c3)

design.entry: useLocalServer.prepareLiveMatch with career.v21 resolved from flags { mobaTacticalDirectorV21: true }, golden live inputs (profile players/lineup, default loadout), roster = mirrored(seed), buildStrategy standard, opponentTeam = aiTeamById(...); blue = the tactic book binding of the arm
design.control: blue = std template binding with no choices (the formal new-game path; note: with no blue tactic at all Live does not call configureMatch)
design.matches: control + 3 arms = 4 x 400 = 1,600 matches (~35-45 min, 3 workers)
design.side: blue only: career.v21 has the player on blue and red is the AI coach; there is no red-side treatment in career

rules.pass: per arm, every claim on blue: same direction, paired z >= 3 and |rel| >= 0.05 (the replication rule)
rules.stop: any claim reversed (directed z <= -3) => STOP, Owner
rules.reportOnly: effect size next to the balanceTool.v21 evidence (rel blue); win rate, duration and gold lead (no win-rate claim)

instrument: a career-path wrapper of the phaseStudySim observation (same per-phase counters and metric definitions; tick loop outside the engine, read-only); to be written with a selftest that cross-checks one balanceTool seed against phaseStudySim bit-identically
rerun: re-run whenever the AI coach or the career.v21 assembly changes (the red side is part of the condition)
